The Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System released “Federal Reserve Balance Sheet: Factors Affecting Reserve Balances — H.4.1” on August 20, 2026. [[SOURCE:SOURCE_1]]

This breaking brief is limited to what the supplied evidence confirms: the release, its title, date, and publisher. It does not report specific balance-sheet figures or offer a market interpretation because the bounded evidence does not support either.

Readers seeking the underlying release should consult the Federal Reserve’s official source.
